content.purpose: Pre-result case proposals for a local Ponytail treatment comparison. This is input material, not a maintained schema, runner, budget authorization, native admission, or acceptance decision.
content.expectedBehaviorTiming: Expected behaviors and evaluator assertions must be frozen before any candidate results are observed.

comparison.baseline: Current strong repository and native-owner instructions, with actual exposure independently recorded.
comparison.candidate: Short distilled owner-aware Ponytail treatment, with exact instruction bytes retained.
comparison.optionalAblation: Exact upstream Full instructions, only if separately included in the predeclared comparison.
comparison.permissions: No case or comparison definition grants execution, budget, publication, native configuration, or acceptance authority.

commonMetricRules.primary: Elapsed time from task delivery to independently verified required completion, including investigation, implementation, required checks and repairs.
commonMetricRules.incompleteRuns: Retain elapsed time, consumed resources, omission and intervention observations. Do not report an incomplete run as a fast completion or silently discard it.
commonMetricRules.optional: Observed native usage and cost, tool calls, repeated reads, repair turns and review effort. Missing native usage or a valid cost basis is unknown, not zero.
commonMetricRules.diagnosticOnly: Source LOC, source bytes, test bytes, files and dependencies. Necessary tests and historical evidence are not bloat.
commonMetricRules.quality: Separately anchored quality judgments; no weighted composite score and no metric-driven adoption.

hardGateDefinitions.evidence-integrity: Exact source, fixture, instruction exposure, evaluator and final-result identities are retained; missing or mismatched evidence is insufficient.
hardGateDefinitions.required-behavior: All case-specific independently authored behavioral assertions hold, including explicitly required negative behavior.
hardGateDefinitions.required-checks: Applicable required checks ran against the exact final tree. Candidate self-report alone does not establish this gate.
hardGateDefinitions.owner-boundary: Use canonical implementations and preserve native ownership; do not add a runtime, registry, credential bridge or duplicate semantic implementation.
hardGateDefinitions.continuity-context: Preserve source currentness, original-answer bindings, historical contracts, effect fences, output bounds and absence of inferred native authority.
hardGateDefinitions.comparator-accounting: Baseline and treatment have equivalent actual exposure except for the declared treatment; account for actual emitted attempts and preserve missing/unknown usage.

cases.taskInput: Add a compact-context command to the existing bun run harness CLI. It accepts one JSON file containing snapshot, context, selection and optional encoding. Reuse the existing canonical compact reader. Omitted encoding returns the existing ordinary compact representation; metadata.v1 requests metadata packing. Preserve the context command and existing source-only semantics. Include appropriate checks for this nontrivial CLI addition.
cases.fixturePreparation: Fresh disposable copy at sourceCommit; no seeded defect. Use synthetic Git Work data from the existing test fixture patterns. All source and any fixture change identities must be retained separately from the candidate result.

sourceAnchors.test: opt-in metadata packing decodes identically without changing normative text

cases.consumer: A source-only CLI caller requesting bounded selected-Task context.
expectedBehavior: The CLI composes resolveGitWorkSelection, openGitWork and readCompactGitWorkContext rather than maintaining another reader or codec.
Ordinary and metadata.v1 results decode to the same independently specified normative fields, Task identity, source bindings and historical effects.
Selection mismatch and unsupported encoding reject; existing context command output remains unchanged for the same snapshot/request.
All returned results remain source-only, bounded by context.maxChars, and preserve held behavior for unavailable or advanced currentness.

metricApplicability.implementationFootprint: Applicable as diagnostic only; check for unnecessary reader/codec/configuration additions.

independentOracle.design: Evaluator-owned assertions invoke the exported runHarness against separately prepared temporary request files and synthetic committed records; no assertions come from candidate output.
deterministicAssertions: Run ordinary and metadata.v1 requests and decode with the source-pinned canonical decoder; compare every independently authored expected field and source address.
Exercise unsupported encoding, mismatched selection.taskId, advanced currentness and irreducible low-budget output; require the corresponding rejection or unusable held result.
Check the existing context command against pre-treatment expected output on the same fixture.
Require applicable common handoff/import and affected Git Work/CLI checks, plus the exact required source-provider closure before any deliverable is considered complete.

evidencePolicy.semanticReview: human-reviewed or model-judged according to the actual independent evaluator; never deterministic from prose/self-report alone

cases.taskInput: We need selected-Task context that fits the existing limit and keeps exact source bindings. Determine whether the repository already supports this and provide the existing API call shape for ordinary and metadata-packed compact output. Do not implement a replacement if the capability exists. Explain the bounded-output refusal and what source qualification establishes.
cases.fixturePreparation: Unmodified fresh sourceCommit. Provide a taskId a example with currentness current and maxChars 12000; no native state or real Work changes are needed.

sourceAnchors.test: all composed serialized statuses fit the requested budget or explicitly reject it

cases.consumer: An engineer choosing an existing common capability before adding code.
expectedBehavior: Identify @palantirkc/work-continuity/git-work and readCompactGitWorkContext as the existing supported facility.
Supply the reader, request and selection arguments, with selection.taskId matching request.taskId; show metadata.v1 only as the optional fourth argument.
State that the reader returns bounded qualified output, held output, or COMPACT_CONTEXT_OUTPUT_BUDGET_TOO_SMALL when even the refusal cannot fit; it does not silently truncate normative data.
Explain that exact Git source qualification grants neither native permission nor semantic acceptance.
Complete with no source, dependency, native configuration or Work record mutation.

metricApplicability.implementationFootprint: Expected zero; fewer added lines cannot distinguish equally correct no-code solutions.
metricApplicability.requiredSourceChecks: No source-change checks are required solely to answer this read-only case.

independentOracle.design: Use predeclared required answer facts plus fixture validation of the described call shapes; snapshot the disposable tree before and after.
deterministicAssertions: All source/dependency/configuration and canonical Work bytes remain unchanged.
Both described call shapes type-check or execute in an evaluator-owned synthetic fixture using the source-pinned public API.
semanticReviewAssertions: The described overflow/currentness behavior matches independently asserted negative cases; do not accept a claim that the CLI already has the new PT-CASE-01 compact-context command at sourceCommit.
Required answer facts include the matching Task selection and the source-proof/native-permission distinction.

evidencePolicy.semanticReview: human-reviewed or model-judged according to the actual independent evaluator; never deterministic from prose/self-report alone

cases.taskInput: A selected Task context exceeds a 1024-character request budget. Make this situation usable for the caller while preserving the complete authored contract, currentness rules and source-only boundary. Do not silently raise the budget or drop required normative text. Determine whether existing refusal behavior already satisfies the requirement; explain the permitted next step.
cases.fixturePreparation: Use evaluator-owned synthetic records following boundRecords and repeatedContracts fixture patterns. Include irreducible oversized normative text, current and advanced variants, and a budget that cannot fit even the compact HOLD wire. Freeze all expected behaviors before the candidate sees the case.

sourceAnchors.test: required output overflow holds without dropping normative clauses or exposing raw originals
composed output and request budgets still refuse rather than truncate

cases.consumer: A context consumer facing a hard serialization limit.
expectedBehavior: Keep the requested limit and existing qualified-versus-held semantics; a refusal can be the correct completed task outcome.
Raw overflow retains REQUIRED_CONTEXT_OUTPUT_LIMIT, unavailable normative coverage and no misleading partial contract.
Compact output fits the exact requested cap or rejects with COMPACT_CONTEXT_OUTPUT_BUDGET_TOO_SMALL; a held compact result cannot decode into usable qualified context.
Do not expose raw answer/question/origin text, weaken source currentness or remove historical effect fences.
Describe reading exact source or explicitly choosing a larger caller budget as a subsequent owner/caller action, without automatically taking that action.

metricApplicability.implementationFootprint: Diagnostic; an unchanged correct implementation is valid.

independentOracle.design: Evaluator-owned synthetic inputs with direct serialized-length, decoder refusal and protected-field assertions; existing tests are supporting anchors rather than the sole oracle.
deterministicAssertions: For every returned object, JSON.stringify(result).length is at most the unchanged requested limit.
An irreducible requirement cannot produce source-qualified partial content; held outputs retain the owned refusal reason and fail decoding as usable context.
Protected original fragments and manufactured native permission never appear in the result.
Unmodified correct existing refusal behavior is accepted; source changes, if any, require the affected package/common checks and exact provider closure.

evidencePolicy.semanticReview: human-reviewed or model-judged according to the actual independent evaluator; never deterministic from prose/self-report alone

cases.taskInput: Review a proposed Git Work update: a completed native Task is relabeled source-only and its native occurrence/execution evidence are removed to simplify the current view. Determine whether the transition is valid. Preserve the original history and provide the concrete validation finding. Do not repair this by erasing or rewriting historical evidence.
cases.fixturePreparation: Prepare an immutable before snapshot from nativeChainRecords, then a distinct proposed after snapshot changing Task a executionClass to source-only and removing occurrence and executionEvidenceId exactly as the anchored regression test does. Preserve both snapshots and all historical receipt bytes. Also provide a separate valid audit-advance control.

sourceAnchors.test: completed native execution cannot be retrospectively relabeled source-only
native prerequisite audit advances retain an already executed receiver's historical receipt

cases.consumer: A Lead reviewing a proposed semantic transition between exact Git snapshots.
expectedBehavior: Use validateGitWorkTransition, directly or through the existing harness transition command, rather than treating independent record validity as sufficient.
Reject the relabeling with COMPLETED_TASK_CONTRACT_HISTORY_CHANGED:a even if the after record set alone is structurally valid.
Retain before/after proposals and native execution/receiver receipts without reset, replay, deletion, retrospective relabeling or invented permission.
Distinguish a valid separate audit milestone advance from rewriting the completed execution contract.

metricApplicability.implementationFootprint: Expected no production change; a correctly evidenced rejection is completion.

independentOracle.design: Evaluator checks exact transition results and byte/blob identities of both immutable snapshots; no candidate-authored PASS is used.
deterministicAssertions: The prohibited transition contains COMPLETED_TASK_CONTRACT_HISTORY_CHANGED:a.
The valid audit-advance control remains valid and the already executed receiver Task and receipt blob identity remain unchanged.
No submitted patch weakens validators or removes protected original/effect/receipt records.
semanticReviewAssertions: The answer does not equate a source-valid snapshot, verification result or proposal with native execution permission or acceptance.

evidencePolicy.semanticReview: human-reviewed or model-judged according to the actual independent evaluator; never deterministic from prose/self-report alone

cases.taskInput: Decomposed Hangul topic aliases no longer resolve, and canonically equivalent duplicate aliases are no longer rejected. Restore both behaviors in the shared documentation code without adding independent normalization rules in callers. Preserve the current NFC, trim and case semantics and the existing transport contract.
cases.fixturePreparation: In a disposable sourceCommit fixture only, remove value.normalize("NFC") from normalizeDocumentationAlias so its return becomes value.trim().toLowerCase(). Retain the exact seeded diff separately. Do not seed or modify the hidden evaluator assertions.

sourceAnchors.test: normalizes Unicode topic aliases and explicit surface names
rejects same-origin but wrong-surface URLs, ambiguous aliases and unsafe provenance

cases.consumer: CLI callers, request parsing, route lookup/index construction and registry collision validation sharing one normalization helper.
expectedBehavior: Fix the root cause once in the canonical helper; inspect request parsing, route indexing, lookup and collision validation callers.
NFC and NFD spellings of the same Hangul alias select the same route; whitespace/case handling remains consistent.
Canonically equivalent aliases assigned to different routes still reject as AMBIGUOUS_TOPIC_ALIAS.
Do not broaden normalization to NFKC or introduce a dependency, wrapper, parallel normalizer, mutable registry or native configuration change.

metricApplicability.implementationFootprint: Diagnostic; the expected root-cause fix is small, so instruction overhead may dominate.

independentOracle.design: Hidden evaluator owns direct helper/request/reader/registry assertions, including an NFD-only alias fixture not copied from candidate tests.
deterministicAssertions: NFC and NFD Hangul inputs select the same independently specified route ID through both direct reader and CLI transport.
An evaluator-owned collision registry with equivalent Unicode aliases on distinct routes rejects with AMBIGUOUS_TOPIC_ALIAS.
NFC-only semantics remain: compatibility characters are not silently converted using NFKC.
All applicable runtime-docs tests, common source checks and exact provider closure pass for the final tree; candidate tests remain a separately assessed quality artifact.

evidencePolicy.semanticReview: human-reviewed or model-judged according to the actual independent evaluator; never deterministic from prose/self-report alone

cases.taskInput: Use the existing documentation reader to determine whether a cached Codex CLI hooks page can be reused. The request is freshness latest with targetVersion 0.162.1; the cache declares the selected canonical page, matching body hashes and that version, but revalidatedInCurrentTask is false. Also explain what changes if that observation is true and what a permissions-topic request requires. Do not fetch, install a connector, inspect credentials or infer an installed version.
cases.fixturePreparation: Use the source-pinned documentation registry and an evaluator-owned observations object. Select the canonical hooks URL from the pinned registry before candidate execution. Use a matching synthetic SHA-256 value for both hash fields. Keep fixture observations as caller claims rather than evidence of actual remote retrieval.

sourceAnchors.test: cache reuse binds canonical page, exact applicable version and confirmed body
sensitive topics require current-task revalidation and gaps retain limited evidence

cases.consumer: A documentation consumer deciding retrieval/reuse with explicit observation limitations.
expectedBehavior: For latest hooks without current-task revalidation, report REVALIDATE_SELECTED_PAGE even when page/version/hash observations match.
With the same matching observations and revalidatedInCurrentTask true, report REUSE_MATCHING_PAGE.
A permissions-topic request without current-task revalidation requires REVALIDATE_SELECTED_PAGE; sensitive-topic policy is preserved.
Treat target version and cache observations as supplied claims, not proof of installation, actual retrieval, compatibility, native authority or complete documentation review.
Reuse the existing reader or harness docs command; make no source/dependency/connector/configuration changes and no remote request.

metricApplicability.implementationFootprint: Expected zero; measure time to a correct retrieval decision rather than code reduction.
metricApplicability.requiredSourceChecks: No source-change check is required solely for this read-only case.

independentOracle.design: Evaluator-owned assertions on the fixed observations matrix plus answer-fact verification and before/after tree identity; do not accept the candidate's prose as proof of cache currentness.
deterministicAssertions: The two hooks observation variants produce the independently specified retrieval labels, with unchanged route identity and nativePermissionGranted false.
The permissions negative case retains its revalidation requirement.
No external call or native configuration effect is emitted; source/dependency/canonical Work bytes remain unchanged.
semanticReviewAssertions: The answer retains route-body-not-fully-reviewed and missing installed-version limitations where present in the source-pinned result.

evidencePolicy.semanticReview: human-reviewed or model-judged according to the actual independent evaluator; never deterministic from prose/self-report alone

pilotInterpretation.repeats: Three paired repeats per case are exploratory; a repeat is not an independent new task distribution.
pilotInterpretation.noAutomaticAdoption: Metrics and evaluator results do not activate native instructions or grant acceptance.
pilotInterpretation.missingEvidence: Missing comparator exposure, required behavior evidence, trace evidence or accounting remains unknown/insufficient; do not fabricate measurements or renormalize weights.
pilotInterpretation.scope: These proposals set no execution budget or permission and perform no native evaluation.
